newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's President Jiang Zemin arrives in HK.
newsitem.headline: China's President Jiang Zemin arrives in HK.

text.p: China's President Jiang Zemin arrived in Hong Kong on Monday afternoon aboard a special flight, becoming the first Chinese head of state to set foot in the British colony.
Jiang was accompanied by other Chinese leaders, the official Xinhua news agency said. His party included Premier Li Peng, and Zhuo Lin, widow of paramount leader Deng Xiaoping.

Jiang's arrival marks the first time a Chinese head of state has visited Hong Kong, which was a mostly barren island when Britain seized it from a weak imperial China under an "unequal treaty" that ended the first Opium War in 1842.

Jiang flew to Hong Kong from the neighbouring Chinese boomtown of Shenzhen, where he arrived on Sunday from Beijing after pledging to ensure the autonomy and freedoms of Hong Kong's 6.4 million people under Beijing rule.

At midnight, Jiang will take back sovereignty over Hong Kong from Britain's Prince Charles in a ceremony that China regards as ending more than a century and a half of national humiliation at the hands of Western imperial powers.
